sourceFitAssessment.learnerTask: Compare equal matrix amount with different fiber organization and separately measured movement.
sourceFitAssessment.gap: The amount/architecture-to-effects Mermaid is a correct causal outline but the hard contrast is spatial. Two tissue sketches with equal labeled collagen area and different alignment/pore structure would support the fictional example, keeping T-cell access as a question to measure.
accuracyGuardrails: Do not show dense matrix as a universal solid wall.
Equal stain area is not equal stiffness or cell access.
No static spatial pattern proves matrix causation or treatment benefit.
sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: Both fields have eight identical nonoverlapping capsule fibers but different arrangements and open gaps. Independent stipulated speeds of 4 micrometers/min in both fields do not supply direction, nest entry or stiffness. Both answered tasks keep amount, architecture, movement, access and causal/treatment claims separate; no static motion or universal wall is drawn.

custody.scope: Complete accepted owner, original matched native pair, code-construction TXT and ordinary provenance JSON. Raw sources, generator execution, captures and original full-review package remain private, not public delivery members.

sourceAccessLimits.NCI: Selected actual metastasis identity/cascade/persistence and angiogenesis/endothelial/VEGF paragraphs read fresh; treatment inventories and recommendations not used.
sourceAccessLimits.selectedRetainedPrimaryText: Personally read Ganley first four retained publisher selections (reagents, culture, phosphorylation caption, ULK1 regulation) and first two paragraphs in each of the two declared Ghajar Results sections. Retained captures are author-custodied primary text, not newly fetched full-paper evidence.
sourceAccessLimits.depthJudgment: Author metadata accurately separates abstract reading, selected full-text passages, acquired-but-unread material and failed XML/limited PubMed routes. No whole-paper, original figure/video or full Methods review certified.
sourceAccessLimits.sourceBoundary: Fictional ratios/counts/speeds and symbolic SVGs are not paper data or patient outcomes. Model-specific vessel/ECM/dormancy results do not become universal therapy claims.
